notes: loss is the batch mean (reduction "mean"), shape [1]; grad_prediction its gradient with respect to the prediction, upstream gradient 1. Both computed in f64 on the f32 inputs and rounded once to f32 (testing-strategy.md §3.3, §3.7); PyTorch's own f32 result meets the tolerance, and training.md §3.3's formulas in f64 agree with PyTorch's f64 result. The config is the loss object without prediction and target; left-out fields take training.md §2.6's defaults.
